summary: Quantizes four float RGBA channel values to a fixed-point texture format. Reads the format identifier at this+4; if it equals 844388420 or 861165636 the per-channel maximum is 15.0, otherwise 255.0, stored at this+4204 (0x106C) with its reciprocal at this+4208 (0x1070). The R channel (this+28) is quantized to 5 bits (round(value*31+0.5) scaled by 1/31), G (this+32) to 6 bits (round(value*63+0.5) scaled by 1/63), B (this+36) to 5 bits, and A (this+40) to the format maximum (round(max*value+0.5) scaled by the reciprocal). Returns the this pointer.

local_names.v1: texture format identifier dword at this+4
local_names.v7: R channel scaled value before truncation
local_names.v4: G channel scaled value before truncation
local_names.v5: B channel scaled value before truncation
local_names.v6: A channel scaled value before truncation

operations.description: Read the format identifier dword from this+4.
Format gate: if the identifier equals 844388420 or 861165636 the channel maximum is 15.0, else 255.0.
Store the selected channel maximum at this+4204 (0x106C).
Quantize R: v7 = this+28 * 31.0 + 0.5; this+28 = trunc(v7) * 0.032258064 (5-bit round-trip).
Quantize G: v4 = this+32 * 63.0 + 0.5; this+32 = trunc(v4) * 0.015873017 (6-bit round-trip).
Quantize B: v5 = this+36 * 31.0 + 0.5; this+36 = trunc(v5) * 0.032258064 (5-bit round-trip).
Quantize A: v6 = this+4204 * this+40 + 0.5; this+40 = trunc(v6) * this+4208 (quantized to the format maximum).
